principle: Expand by missing detector value and source-risk class. Do not train a classifier until each promoted label has enough independently sourced, human-confirmed examples and the benchmark remains separate.

priorityTiers.name: low-risk external expansion
priorityTiers.sourceStrategy: rights-cleared adult creator-owned or explicitly licensed photography
priorityTiers.notes: Prioritize contemporary Artes-like photography. Human adult/model-rights evidence remains mandatory for recognizable people.

priorityTiers.name: adult explicit anatomy coverage
priorityTiers.sourceStrategy: explicitly authorized adult creator-owned sources only
priorityTiers.notes: Coverage value is technical, not style calibration. Keep provenance and rights evidence unusually strict.

priorityTiers.name: high-sensitivity moderation coverage
priorityTiers.sourceStrategy: curated specialist datasets or explicit contributor authorization; no casual web scraping
priorityTiers.notes: Do not source these ad hoc from social platforms. Preserve separation between detector evidence and final policy.
